prose: The Wall Street Journal reports that pharmaceutical leaders doubt claims that AI could cure most diseases within a decade. No AI-designed drug has won FDA clearance, and pharma leaders say biology, not computing, is the obstacle.
highlights: Pharma leaders skeptical AI will cure most diseases within a decade
No AI-designed drug has FDA clearance; biology is the obstacle, per WSJ
